query:
UPDATE molecules SET 
  radar_intensity = 75,
  radar_freshness = 95,
  radar_warmth = 15,
  radar_sweetness = 30,
  radar_spiciness = 40,
  radar_earthiness = 25
WHERE (olfactiveProfile LIKE '%menthe%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%mint%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%frais%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%fresh%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%eucalyptus%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%camphor%')
  AND radar_intensity = 50 AND radar_freshness = 50
